result.brief: DreamFormer 用任务无关 Transformer 世界模型在潜空间想象中模仿专家演示，并将多视角高分辨率观测压缩为单 token 以支持长时序想象，提升语言条件机器人操作与零样本迁移。
result.reason: Transformer world model with single-token multi-view observation encoding for latent imagination; robot manipulation application, so primary direction is world-model applications.
